title: bay-breeze-cooling: models and data for air-first, seawater-backup hybrid cooling of an above-water data center on San Francisco Bay
description: Code, data and figures for the preprint "Breeze First, Seawater Second: Hybrid Cooling for an Above-Water Offshore Data Center on San Francisco Bay Within California's Discharge Limit". Includes hourly climate and Bay water data processing, two-stage epsilon-NTU heat-exchanger sizing, annual energy and seawater-use models under a 2.2 K discharge limit, robustness checks, a vendor exchanger cross-check and digitised CFD results.
